app.name: InverterScout
showcase.add_note: This adds an in-memory sample. No device or cloud account is contacted.
setup.title: Welcome to InverterScout
setup.subtitle: Complete this one-time setup before monitoring starts.
setup.timezone_help: Start typing an English IANA time zone name, such as Europe/Warsaw, America/New_York, or Asia/Tokyo.
setup.inverter_help: InverterScout supports the LuxPower SNA-series protocol. SNA5000 WPV / Eco is the verified model.
setup.serial_help: Enter the 10-character values printed on your inverter and Wi-Fi dongle. They are never sent to InverterScout servers.
setup.telegram_help: Create a private bot with @BotFather, copy its token, then obtain your numeric chat ID. New users still require manual approval in the Access page.
setup.web_warning: The web interface is intended for your home network. Do not forward this port on your router and do not expose it directly to the internet. Use Telegram for remote access.
setup.security_help: Settings, device credentials, Telegram users, events, and runtime state are encrypted before they are written to the local SQLite database.
setup.completed: Setup is complete. InverterScout is starting…
setup.validation_error: Review the highlighted settings and try again.
setup.error_timezone: Enter a valid IANA time zone.
setup.error_host: Enter a valid hostname or IP address.
setup.error_serial: Serial number must contain exactly 10 letters or digits.
setup.error_poll_interval: Polling interval must be between 10 and 3600 seconds.
setup.error_telegram: A valid bot token and numeric administrator chat ID are required.

settings.restart_note: Runtime connection changes take effect after InverterScout restarts.
settings.saved: Settings saved. Restart InverterScout to apply connection changes.

telegram.alert_voltage_normal:

telegram.alert_no_consumption:
⚠️ *{device}*: no consumption for {minutes} min.
The connected appliance may have stopped drawing power.
🔄 InverterScout will power-cycle the plug once, wait 10 seconds, and check again.
telegram.alert_no_consumption_after_recy:
🔴 *{device}*: still at 0 W after another {minutes} min.
No further automatic action will be taken. Check the appliance manually.
telegram.waiting_for_data: ⚠️ No inverter data yet. InverterScout is waiting for the first response.
telegram.source_low_voltage:
🟡 Grid: *LOW VOLTAGE* ({voltage:.0f} V)
⚠️ Running on battery.
telegram.help_full:
ℹ️ *InverterScout*

Automatic alerts cover grid outages, low voltage, grid recovery, generator state, and low battery.

*Commands:*
/start - show status
/stop - unsubscribe
/battery - battery and inverter status
/devices - smart devices
/device_on - turn on a device
/device_off - turn off a device
/help - show this help
